In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two stories shaping Indian and global markets:
Story 1: China’s IPO Boom and a New Financing Model
China’s biggest chip IPO has sparked a debate about whether the country is moving away from its state-led financing model toward capital markets. We explore how AI, technology listings, and stock market reforms are reshaping China’s economy—and whether this shift can sustain long-term growth.
